name: Steeled Fist
description: Throw a fist from a steeled brow with the will set so hard that the blow does not soften on impact.

name: Steeled Guard
description: Set the brow against the blow and let a shell of steeled will form over the arms and chest.

name: Steeled Stride
description: Stride with the brow level and the will fixed so that the body goes where the mind has set it.

name: Steeled Press
description: Lean the whole steeled will onto the opponent until their qi sinks and their guard grows slow.

name: Steeled Hold
description: Hold the steeled posture while the shell of will turns blow after blow without a crack.

name: Steeled Calm
description: Pass the steeled calm across to a shaken ally until their hands stop trembling and their eyes clear.

name: Steeled Blow
description: Drive the whole steeled will into one blow that breaks the guard before it and the stance behind.

name: Steeled Shell
description: Spread the steeled will over the nearby allies as a shared shell that thins the force of every blow.

name: Resolve Immovable
description: Plant a will no force can shift and press down on every foe that strikes against it.

name: Immovable Brow
description: The school's closing stand in which the brow takes a blow without moving and returns it with strength scaling to the force absorbed.

name: Diadem Fist
description: Throw a fist with the head held as if crowned and the will worn like a ring of light.

name: Diadem Guard
description: Raise a ring of will above the brow and bring it down round the body as a thin bright shell.

name: Diadem Stride
description: Stride with the head held proud and let the ring of will carry the body forward.

name: Diadem Voice
description: Speak one commanding word to an ally and send a ring of will down onto their head to steady it.

name: Diadem Weight
description: Lay a heavy ring of will onto the opponent's head and press their qi down beneath it.

name: Diadem Shield
description: Wear the ring of will as a standing ward that grows brighter and harder under attack.

name: Diadem Lend
description: Lend a ring of the user's will to an ally for as long as the user holds it in mind.

name: Diadem Clearing
description: Pass a ring of clear will over an ally's mind and wipe off the dread or enchantment clinging to it.

name: Diadem Crash
description: Bring the whole ring of will down in one blow that crashes through guard and bone alike.

name: Diadem Decree
description: Proclaim a decree from beneath the ring of will so that all foes in earshot are pressed to the ground.

name: Diadem Judgment
description: Pass judgment from beneath the crown of will so the foe is struck and held beneath the sentence.

name: Commanding Crown
description: The school's crowning move that settles a crown of will over the field and presses every foe down with weight scaling to the reserve.

name: Unbroken Knuckle
description: Throw a fist that has been pledged never to break and let the pledge carry through the impact.

name: Unbroken Guard
description: Hold the pledged guard and refuse to let the first blow become the last.

name: Unbroken Stride
description: Stride on a pledge not to falter and let the step carry past what would stop an unpledged man.

name: Unbroken Press
description: Press on the opponent without a pause until the pledge outlasts their will to resist.

name: Unbroken Ward
description: Hold a ward over the body that the pledge keeps whole through a long onslaught.

name: Unbroken Spur
description: Share the pledge with a flagging ally and spur them to keep on past the point of collapse.

name: Unbroken Unbinding
description: Hold the pledge over an ally in a hostile will's grip until the grip loosens and falls away.

name: Unbroken Crash
description: Hurl the full pledged weight into the foe so that it breaks through every guard set against it.

name: Unbroken Aegis
description: Spread the pledge as an aegis over the nearby allies so no one under it is left bare.

name: Pledge Unbound
description: Hold the foe with the pledge and then strike them with the full weight of every promise kept.

name: Pledge Everlasting
description: The school's defining move: a blow lands and lends its weight to every ally in reach with strength scaling to the pledge.

name: Anchored Knuckle
description: Throw a fist from a stance that feels fixed to the sky above and drives the blow straight down.

name: Anchor Guard
description: Hold a guard that feels tethered high above so no blow can drag the body off its line.

name: Anchor Stride
description: Stride along a line anchored in the sky so that the step cannot be knocked off its course.

name: Anchor Press
description: Pull the opponent's will toward the ground with an anchored weight that does not ease.

name: Anchored Hold
description: Hold the body fixed against all pushing with a will anchored far above the fight.

name: Anchor Release
description: Cut a hostile tether from an ally's mind with a single clear stroke of anchored will.

name: Anchored Plunge
description: Drop from the anchored height with the whole weight of the sky behind a single downward blow.

name: Anchor Rally
description: Tether every ally nearby to the same anchored will so none of them can be forced back.

name: Sky Anchor
description: Drop a vast anchor of will from the sky that holds the user fast and bears down on every foe near.

name: Skyfast Verdict
description: The school's high move: a verdict drops from the anchor to pierce the foe and bind their will with force scaling to the reserve.

name: Pact Fist
description: Throw a fist in keeping of the pact with the wind and let the pact give the blow its drive.

name: Pact Guard
description: Stand in the posture of the pact and let a shell of will rise where the wind would strike.

name: Pact Stride
description: Stride with the wind at the back as the pact allows and cover the ground in one long step.

name: Pact Press
description: Press the pact into the foe with a blow that lands and sinks their qi.

name: Pact Ward
description: Hold a ward of will in keeping of the pact that does not tire against the longest assault.

name: Pact Lend
description: Lend the strength of the pact to the nearest allies so their blows fall steadier and harder.

name: Pact Unbinding
description: Break a hostile hold on an ally's mind by speaking the older pact over it.

name: Pact Hammer
description: Drive all the weight of the pact into a single downward blow that no ordinary guard can turn.

name: Pact Rally
description: Call the pact over every ally within reach and wrap each of them in a shell of shared will.

name: Pact Sealed
description: Seal the foe's qi behind the pact so that it will not answer them until the pact is lifted.

name: Pact Tempest
description: The school's closing move: the pact breaks as a tempest over the foes and steels the allies with force scaling to the reserve.

name: Resolute Fist
description: Throw a fist with a wind-hard resolve that does not slacken even when the target gives way.

name: Resolute Guard
description: Set the guard against the wind and keep it set however hard the blow is thrown.

name: Resolute Stride
description: Stride on without turning the head or the shoulder aside from the way set before the step.

name: Resolute Press
description: Press into the foe with a wind of will that gains weight the longer it blows.

name: Resolute Brace
description: Brace the whole body against a gale of force and let the resolute will hold every joint.

name: Resolute Clearing
description: Blow a clean wind of will through a clouded mind and carry off the poison of fear in it.

name: Resolute Smash
description: Smash through the guard with a wind-hard blow that leaves the foe's qi pinned flat.

name: Resolute Shell
description: Spread a resolute shell over the nearby allies and let each of them draw nerve from the user.

name: Wind Unbowed
description: Hold a wind that will not bow and loose it on the foe as a strike that pins their will to the ground.

name: Stubborn Wind
description: The school's defining move in which the wind of will flings back each force it meets with strength scaling to the blow absorbed.

name: Tenacious Fist
description: Throw a fist that clings to its mark and keeps pressing after the first impact.

name: Tenacious Guard
description: Hold a guard that clings to the line it set and will not be pried from it.

name: Tenacious Stride
description: Stride on steadily with a will that hangs on to the chosen path and does not lose it.

name: Tenacious Word
description: Speak a clinging word to an ally that keeps their resolve from slipping away.

name: Tenacious Press
description: Cling to the foe with a will that presses and does not relent until their qi has sunk.

name: Tenacious Hold
description: Cling to the stance through every blow with a shell of will that never loosens.

name: Tenacious Counter
description: Take a blow and send its force back along the line it came by in an unbroken return.

name: Tenacious Release
description: Refuse to let a hostile will keep its hold on an ally and wear it away until it lets go.

name: Tenacious Smash
description: Smash the same point again and again with the clinging will until the guard gives out.

name: Tenacious Revival
description: Refuse to let a person who has just stopped breathing go and hold the will on them until the heart answers.

name: Tenacious Gale
description: Raise a clinging gale of will that presses every foe in the field and refuses to let up.

name: Eternal Resolve
description: The school's defining move: the user returns a blow with the held weight of unending resolve and lends the same to allies.

name: Deepset Fist
description: Throw a fist from a will set deep as a root so the blow is driven from far below the shoulder.

name: Deepset Guard
description: Sink the will deep beneath the guard and let a blow find no purchase to push against.

name: Deepset Stride
description: Stride on a deepset will that draws strength up through the legs at every step.

name: Deepset Press
description: Bear down on the foe with a will from deep below that flattens their qi against the ground.

name: Deepset Hold
description: Hold a shell of will rooted so deep that no blow can lift or shift the user.

name: Deepset Cleansing
description: Draw a deep will up through an ally and push out the fear or compulsion lodged in the mind.

name: Deepset Crash
description: Crash down with the weight of the root behind the blow so that nothing in front of it holds.

name: Deepset Rally
description: Send the deep root of will out beneath the nearby allies and brace each one from below.

name: Deepset Oath
description: Call the oath up from its deepest root and strike the foe's will directly with a force that no guard can bar.

name: Stormbound Oath
description: The school's final move: the oath rises as a tempest that strikes the foes and shields the user with force scaling to the reserve.
